messages:
Janelle (Partnerships): Quick sync — we need SI ramp week aligned with the marketplace listing and the hardware voucher drop. Goal: run enablement Tues–Thu, soft launch Fri. Who can own voucher SKU + shipping timeline?

Ali (SI Program): I can own SI comms + certification logistics. Do we have confirmation on marketplace publish date? Need 2 weeks lead for dev kits.

Marco (Marketplace): Listing currently scheduled for 2027-06-09 (tentative). Need productID and 1-pager. Also legal needs a joint announcement copy. Can someone drop the assets by EOD Monday?

Sarah (HW Ops): Voucher SKU ready, shipping windows: standard 5–7 business days; expedited 2 days if we pre-fund. Voucher snippet:
```
SKU: RW-SI-VCHR-2027
TYPE: physical-kit
TTL: 30d
```
If we want expedited, we need a PO and address list by Tue.

Olivia (Enablement): Training plan: 3x 90-min sessions + hands-on lab (Docker + local runtimes). Certification exam will be online proctored; need proctor slots. Suggest pre-reqs: basic infra + git + docker. I'll publish a checklist and a short quiz by Mon.

devbot (calendar-bot): Created: "SI Ramp Week — Enablement" 2027-06-15T09:00 - 2027-06-17T17:00. Invite sent to participants.

Ali (SI Program): Can someone own the joint PR? I'll coordinate exam scheduling and candidate invites.

Janelle (Partnerships): I'll draft the PR and send to Marco + Legal for review. Sarah, please lock in expedited option if Ali confirms PO by Tue. Olivia, please add a "what to bring" note for hardware lab (serial cables, power adaptors).

Marco (Marketplace): Ack — I'll queue the listing once we have the productID + 1-pager. Legal: ping @legal-team for the joint announcement copy.

Sarah (HW Ops): Will prepare address template and expedited cost estimate. Expect to upload by Tue noon.

Olivia (Enablement): Will publish checklist, quiz, and lab network diagram. Link will be in the calendar invite.

Janelle (Partnerships): Action items captured. I'll follow up with a quick doc. :thumbsup:
